name: Paddle
notes: Derived from Paddle's known checkout structure — validate on first use and record variants back into this recipe.

steps.addToCart: 'Buy'/'Checkout' opens the Paddle overlay iframe (buy.paddle.com); target fields THROUGH frameLocator on that iframe — page-level selectors do not reach it. Hosted buy.paddle.com pages keep inputs in the top frame.
steps.contact: input[name=email]; country/postcode (Paddle is merchant of record and collects tax location).
steps.payment: Direct inputs (not Stripe): input[name=cardNumber] / input[autocomplete=cc-number], expiry (required), then the CVV token into input[autocomplete=cc-csc] immediately after the number.
steps.placeOrder: 'Pay' / 'Subscribe now' inside the same frame, once.
